theorem.name: ConditionalK3PeriodSchurSelectionTheorem
theorem.statement: If C_Xi_fixed holds for a C2 extension Xi_ext over the 18-complex-dimensional K3 period domain, the implicit-function theorem eliminates the fixed-sector fields and the exact period selector is the 36-real-dimensional Schur complement H_eff. Existing fixed-field positivity alone neither selects nor stabilizes a K3 period.
